related_questions.question: What is the life expectancy of someone with TBI?

text_blocks.snippet: Life expectancy is reduced for individuals with moderate to severe traumatic brain injuries (TBI), with an average reduction of about 7-9 years compared to the general population. The severity of the TBI, age, and pre-existing health conditions all play a role in determining the extent of this reduction.
snippet_highlighted_words: Life expectancy is reduced for individuals with moderate to severe traumatic brain injuries (TBI), with an average reduction of about 7-9 years compared to the general population

list.title: Severity of TBI:
list.snippet: Moderate to severe TBIs significantly impact life expectancy, with a greater reduction than mild TBIs.

list.title: Age:
list.snippet: Older individuals with TBI tend to have a shorter life expectancy than younger individuals.

list.title: Functional Status:
list.snippet: Individuals with greater mobility and independence tend to have longer life expectancies.

list.title: Specific Causes of Death:
list.snippet: TBI survivors are at increased risk of death from seizures, pneumonia, infections, and drug poisoning, among other causes.
A study found that individuals with TBI were twice as likely to die as those in the general population, with an average reduction of 7 years in life expectancy.
According to the CDC, a moderate to severe TBI can reduce life expectancy by about 9 years.
A study of survivors of moderate to severe TBI who received inpatient rehabilitation showed a reduction in life expectancy of 7 years.
Individuals who were unable to walk or were fed by others after TBI had the shortest life expectancy.

list.title: Post-injury survival:
list.snippet: Studies show that mortality rates are higher in the first few months after TBI, but decrease within 6-12 months.

list.title: Rehabilitation:
list.snippet: Receiving inpatient rehabilitation services can improve survival rates and potentially increase life expectancy, but the reduction in life expectancy compared to the general population still exists.

list.title: Individual Variation:
list.snippet: Life expectancy is not the same for everyone with TBI. Factors like age, severity of injury, and individual health can significantly affect outcomes.
